source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 18 item and command target memory-error metadata, but the Procedure also requires Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other SMBIOS structures. One Type 18 command cannot satisfy the full named coverage, and the source does not say whether these fields are intentional companions or copied defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and the conflict record are complete. Execution waits for owner field mapping and matrices, but this normal engineering decision does not stop review of later cases.

review_improvement: Preserves every named field and both same-code variants while preventing a header-only Type 18 capture from being counted as complete multi-structure evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 18 has defined memory-error attributes, whereas chassis status, serial and security belong to different SMBIOS structures. A parser cannot legitimately manufacture those fields from Type 18, and silently ignoring them would regress explicit Procedure coverage. The safe path is a field ownership decision followed by structure-specific captures, because combining unscoped dmidecode text would also risk matching identical labels from the wrong record.
